Hi all —

Thanks for scheduling. Quick technical agenda and prep items from my side: 

Agenda (45m):
- 5m: Introductions and scope confirmation
- 15m: Network design & connectivity (VPC peering, DirectConnect/VPN patterns, CIDR planning)
- 10m: Authentication & KMS (customer-managed keys, HSM options, key rotation)
- 10m: Runtime topology (node sizing, GPU pools, autoscaling, caching)
- 5m: Rollout plan & next steps

Prep items for FintechCo: 
- Please confirm public/private CIDR ranges and NAT/firewall constraints (we saw a spreadsheet attached earlier).
- If you have particular compliance evidence requests beyond SOC2, drop them into the pre-read folder so we can address them live.

For the on-prem path: please confirm whether you require an air-gapped appliance (no outbound) or a customer-managed VPC with limited egress — both have different operational tradeoffs we'll cover.

I'll bring a short diagram and sample network ACLs; Connor will join for rollout sequencing.
